mission: NASA POWER (Prediction of Worldwide Energy Resources)
source: NASA Langley Research Center (LaRC) / MERRA-2 / GEOS-5 FP-IT

variables.name: Temperature at 2 Meters
variables.description: Monthly average air temperature at 2 meters above ground level from MERRA-2 assimilation.
variables.detective_hint: Detects thermal warming anomalies, heat domes, and macro-climatic shift trends.

variables.name: Maximum Temperature at 2 Meters
variables.description: Monthly mean of daily maximum 2-meter air temperature.
variables.detective_hint: Crucial for detecting heatwave intensification and agricultural heat stress limits.

variables.name: Minimum Temperature at 2 Meters
variables.description: Monthly mean of daily minimum 2-meter air temperature.
variables.detective_hint: Tracks nocturnal warming rates; nocturnal warming often outpaces daytime warming.

variables.name: Earth Skin Temperature
variables.description: Radiative surface skin temperature of the land or canopy surface.
variables.detective_hint: Direct analog to MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST); responds instantaneously to deforestation.

variables.name: Precipitation Corrected Total
variables.description: Monthly bias-corrected precipitation accumulation combining satellite gauge calibrations.
variables.detective_hint: Validates meteorological drought against agricultural and hydrological drought indicators.

variables.name: Relative Humidity at 2 Meters
variables.description: Ratio of actual vapor pressure to saturation vapor pressure at 2m.
variables.detective_hint: Declines in RH combined with warming signal atmospheric drying and higher VPD.

variables.name: All Sky Surface Shortwave Downward Irradiance
variables.description: Total solar insolation reaching Earth surface under all atmospheric conditions.
variables.detective_hint: Monitors solar dimming/brightening trends from aerosol and cloud cover variations.

variables.name: Clear Sky Surface Shortwave Downward Irradiance
variables.description: Solar irradiance incident at the surface under clear sky aerosol conditions.
variables.detective_hint: Isolates atmospheric aerosol loading and orbital trends from cloud interference.

variables.name: All Sky Surface Longwave Downward Irradiance
variables.description: Thermal infrared radiation emitted downwards by atmospheric gases and clouds.
variables.detective_hint: Tracks surface greenhouse effect forcing and water vapor trap efficiency.

variables.name: Total Evapotranspiration
variables.description: Water flux from soil evaporation and plant transpiration into the boundary layer.
variables.detective_hint: Collapses when soil moisture is exhausted or vegetative cover is stripped.

variables.name: Surface Soil Wetness (0-5cm)
variables.description: Degree of saturation in the top 5cm active soil layer (0 to 1).
variables.detective_hint: Quickly responds to recent precipitation and rapid evaporation episodes.

variables.name: Root Zone Soil Wetness (0-100cm)
variables.description: Available soil water in the crop root zone (0-100cm depth fraction).
variables.detective_hint: Direct driver of agricultural productivity and forest drought survival.

variables.name: Profile Soil Moisture Saturation
variables.description: Deep profile soil moisture saturation fraction down to bedrock/water table.
variables.detective_hint: Reveals deep multi-year aquifer and bedrock hydrology depletion trends.

variables.name: Daytime Cloud Coverage
variables.description: Total cloud fraction during daytime solar viewing conditions.
variables.detective_hint: Key factor modulating daytime surface temperatures and convective precipitation.

variables.name: Wind Speed at 10 Meters
variables.description: Mean horizontal wind speed at 10 meters anemometer height.
variables.detective_hint: Identifies regional circulation shifts, atmospheric stilling, and wind erosion hazard.

variables.name: Wind Speed at 50 Meters
variables.description: Mean horizontal wind speed at 50 meters hub height.
variables.detective_hint: Evaluates wind power trends and upper surface boundary momentum transfer.

variables.name: Surface Pressure
variables.description: Atmospheric pressure measured at surface topography elevation.
variables.detective_hint: Detects monsoon trough deepening, subtropical ridge migration, and anticyclonic blocks.

variables.name: Specific Humidity at 2 Meters
variables.description: Mass of water vapor per unit mass of moist air.
variables.detective_hint: Absolute measure of moisture availability independent of ambient temperature.

variables.name: Total Column Ozone
variables.description: Total atmospheric column ozone abundance in Dobson Units (DU).
variables.detective_hint: Tracks stratospheric ozone recovery, UV-B surface flux risk, and Brewer-Dobson circulation.

variables.name: Aerosol Optical Depth at 550nm
variables.description: Extinction of solar radiation at 550nm due to dust, smoke, sulfates, and nitrates.
variables.detective_hint: Crucial for detecting biomass burning smoke plumes, dust storms, and industrial haze.
